_comment: Label corrections from auditing the pool. Each promotion has a justification INDEPENDENT of the graph feature that surfaced it — otherwise this is just training on the model's own output. Contested acts are moved to 'borderline' and excluded from training rather than forced to a side.

promote_to_jam.Dead Floyd: Grateful Dead / Pink Floyd tribute act — name and repertoire
promote_to_jam.BERTHA: Grateful Drag: Grateful Dead tribute ('Bertha' is a Dead song)
promote_to_jam.Melvin Seals and JGB: Jerry Garcia Band; spelling variant of 'Melvin Seals & JGB' already in the curated list
promote_to_jam.Sicard Hollow: Last.fm tags are explicitly 'jam band, jamgrass' — tag evidence, independent of the graph
promote_to_jam.Daniel Donato: bare-name variant of 'Daniel Donato's Cosmic Country' already in the curated list
promote_to_jam.Mountain Grass Unit: jamgrass act on the festival circuit
promote_to_jam.Sam Grisman Project: Grisman/Garcia lineage, plays the Dead and newgrass repertoire

move_to_borderline.Mark O'Connor: bluegrass/fiddle virtuoso; crosses into the scene but is not of it
move_to_borderline.Charlie Hunter: jazz guitarist who works the jam circuit
move_to_borderline.John Scofield: same — jazz with deep jam-circuit ties
move_to_borderline.The Steepwater Band: blues/southern rock on the jam circuit
move_to_borderline.The California Honeydrops: roots/soul act that works the jam festival circuit
